{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id values
print(f'Duplicate patient_id counts: {data["patient_id"].duplicated().sum()}')

# Confirm that sample_seq varies per patient
sample_seq_stats = data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].nunique().describe()
print(f'Unique sample_seq counts per patient:
{sample_seq_stats}')

# Check if any patient has more than one sample_seq
multi_sample_patients = data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].nunique().gt(1).sum()
print(f'Number of patients with multiple sample_seq: {multi_sample_patients}')

# Note: The documentation says to keep the highest sample_seq per patient
# So we will deduplicate using the highest sample_seq

# Deduplicate: keep row with highest sample_seq per patient
deduplicated_data = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Final number of unique patients
num_unique_patients = deduplicated_data.shape[0]
print(f'Number of unique patients after deduplication: {num_unique_patients}')"}
